mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order_info` (id, user_id, status, total_amount, pay_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, remark) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.status, o.total_amount, o.pay_amount, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.remark, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.cancelled_at, i.id AS item_id, i.sku_id, i.sku_name, i.price, i.quantity, i.amount FROM `order_info` o LEFT JOIN `order_item` i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE `order_info` SET status = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
